## README.md
# GLOBIO 4 — Terrestrial Mean Species Abundance (MSA)

Global maps of **local terrestrial biodiversity intactness**, expressed as the **Mean Species
Abundance (MSA)** indicator, from **GLOBIO 4** (Schipper et al. 2020). MSA is the mean, over
species, of each species' present-day abundance relative to its abundance in an undisturbed
reference situation (truncated at 1): **MSA = 1** → fully intact assemblage; **MSA → 0** →
highly degraded. Values are dimensionless in **[0, 1]**.

- **Source:** PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency — GLOBIO 4.
  Schipper, A.M., Hilbers, J.P., Meijer, J.R., et al. (2020) *Projecting terrestrial biodiversity
  intactness with GLOBIO 4.* Global Change Biology 26:760–771. https://doi.org/10.1111/gcb.14848
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0.
- **Native grid:** 10 arc-seconds (~300 m at the equator), EPSG:4326, Float32, NoData = `-999`.

## Layers

Four time/scenario slices × three taxonomic layers:

| Slice | Meaning | Year |
|---|---|---|
| `2015` | present-day baseline | 2015 |
| `ssp1rcp26-2050` | Sustainability (SSP1 × RCP2.6) | 2050 |
| `ssp3rcp60-2050` | Regional rivalry (SSP3 × RCP6.0) | 2050 |
| `ssp5rcp85-2050` | Fossil-fuelled development (SSP5 × RCP8.5) | 2050 |

| Layer | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `overall` | Overall MSA (mean of plants, birds, mammals) |
| `plants` | MSA for plants |
| `wbvert` | MSA for warm-blooded vertebrates (birds + mammals) |

Each `globio-msa-<slice>-<layer>` dataset provides a **COG** (`…-cog.tif`) for visualization and an
**H3 hex** parquet (`…/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet`, native resolution **8**, also carrying `h0`) for
spatial joins and aggregation. Hex cells hold the **area-weighted mean** MSA of the pixels they
cover (`mean` reducer — MSA is a bounded index, never summed).

## Visualize the COG (titiler / MapLibre)

```js
// Continuous 0–1 colormap; nodata -999 is transparent
const cog = "https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-globio/globio-msa-2015-overall-cog.tif";
map.addSource("msa", {
  type: "raster",
  tiles: [`https://titiler.../cog/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}?url=${encodeURIComponent(cog)}` +
          `&rescale=0,1&colormap_name=rdylgn`],
  tileSize: 256,
});
map.addLayer({ id: "msa", type: "raster", source: "msa" });
```

## Query the hex (DuckDB)

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;

-- Mean intactness per H3 res-8 cell, 2015 baseline
SELECT h8, msa
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-globio/globio-msa-2015-overall/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
LIMIT 10;

-- 2015 → SSP5×RCP8.5 change per cell (join on the shared h8 key)
SELECT b.h8, b.msa AS msa_2015, s.msa AS msa_ssp5, s.msa - b.msa AS delta
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-globio/globio-msa-2015-overall/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') b
JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-globio/globio-msa-ssp5rcp85-2050-overall/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') s
  USING (h8);
```

MSA is a per-area intensity: to summarize over a region, take an **area-weighted mean** (H3 cells
are ~equal-area per resolution, so a plain `AVG(msa)` is a good approximation), **never** `SUM`.
